# dgx-spark-llm-serving

> Field notes and an operational guard for local vLLM serving on NVIDIA DGX Spark, covering model selection, serving flags, generation wedges, multi-node links, and unattended recovery.

## Project documentation

- [README.md](README.md): Records measured serving behavior, deployment flags, failure modes, fleet networking, and reliability practices.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): Contains the MIT license terms.

## Operations

- [scripts/engine-guard.sh](scripts/engine-guard.sh): Probes real text generation and restarts a wedged vLLM container after repeated failures.
